steps.stdout:
start (or reuse) the local dashboard and print its URL

Usage:
  agent-exec ui [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                 help for ui
      --idle-minutes float   exit after N idle minutes (default 30)
      --json                 JSON output
      --open                 open the URL in a browser
      --port int             port of --serve (default: any free port)
      --stop                 stop the dashboard
